name: Land of Punt
summary: An ancient kingdom known from Ancient Egyptian trade records.

checks.identity: Vital Articles state without Cliopatria borders

not_applicable.capital: no capital is known; the location of Punt itself is disputed and Egyptian records name no royal city
not_applicable.key_figures: the only rulers named are King Parahu and Queen Ati on the Hatshepsut reliefs; neither has a Wikidata item to link
not_applicable.before: first known state of its region; known only from Egyptian records
not_applicable.after: no successor state is known; Punt drops out of the Egyptian records
